description: Erection of canopies to south-west elevation with folding/sliding doors to side and front to provide weather protection to existing hardstanding area
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A010119/DP2 (Rev. A)  Received:  03 April 2019; A010119/S01, A010119/S02, A010119/S03, Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  05 March 2019; A010119/DP1, A010119/DP3, A010119/DP4  Received:  18 February 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The approved canopies shall be constructed only using the materials specified in the approved details.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the first use of the proposed canopies, the existing temporary marquees located on the clubhouse's rear balcony shall be removed in full and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first use of the proposed canopies, full details (including manufacturer's specifications, means of enclosure and location within the site) of two additional cycle parking spaces required for the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout, and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
